title: Design System: RTARIUM by HEMISPHERE ONE

name.purpose: RTARIUM set as type in the opening and the footer, in Anybody at 150% width.

figure.purpose: The one large tabular number on a technical screen.

shadows.name: capsule-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft lift under the brand capsule.

shadows.name: capsule-edge-on-black
shadows.purpose: Yellow hairline edge for the capsule on a black ground.

shadows.name: footage-drop
shadows.purpose: Long soft shadow under the footage frame.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals, hovers and slabs.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetrical movement of grounds and panels.

motion.name: word-step
motion.purpose: Gap between words as headings rise (95ms for the challenge statement).

components.name: Solid Pill
components.description: Primary action pill (Contact in the header).
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:46px; padding:0 22px; border:1.5px solid #080808; border-radius:999px; background:#080808; color:#fdd001; font-size:0.9375rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill:hover { background:transparent; color:#080808; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Ink Pill
components.css: .ds-pill-ink { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:56px; padding:0 28px; border:1.5px solid #080808; border-radius:999px; background:#080808; color:#fdd001; font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill-ink:hover { background:transparent; color:#080808; } .ds-pill-ink:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Explore Slab
components.description: Square slab with an arrow cell; yellow runs back over it on hover.
components.html: Explore the mesh
components.css: .ds-explore { display:inline-flex; align-items:stretch; height:60px; background:#080808; color:#fdd001; text-decoration:none; } .ds-explore__label { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 24px; font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-explore__cell { display:grid; place-items:center; width:60px; border-left:1px solid rgb(253 208 1 / 0.35); } .ds-explore:hover { background:#fdd001; color:#080808; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #080808; } .ds-explore:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Brand Capsule
components.description: Black pill that keeps both logos in full colour on every ground.
components.css: .ds-brand { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:11px 20px 11px 16px; border-radius:999px; background:#080808; color:#f2f0e9; box-shadow:0 6px 18px -10px rgb(8 8 8 / 0.55); } .ds-brand__rt { font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.02em; color:#fdd001; } .ds-brand__by { padding-left:14px; border-left:1px solid rgb(242 240 233 / 0.28); font-size:11px; }

components.name: Heading Slab
components.description: A heading line set on a block of the inverse colour.
components.css: .ds-slab { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:0.08em; margin:0; font-size:2.6rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.02; } .ds-slab span { padding:0.04em 0.18em 0.12em 0.14em; background:#080808; color:#fdd001; }

components.name: Progress Step
components.description: Square chip that names a step and fills while it plays.
components.css: .ds-step { display:flex; align-items:center; height:36px; min-width:110px; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:#080808; color:#fdd001; font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: The site is a presentation, not a page. Every screen is a full-height field of one colour that says one thing, and the only object with real depth is the basalt mesh itself, drawn in WebGL. Everything around it is flat, hard-edged and exact: blocks of yellow, black and warm white, hairline leaders, numbered notes, and headings set on slabs of the inverse colour so they read over anything.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow is the majority colour; black is ink and the ground of technical screens; warm white replaces white.
The mesh keeps its own basalt-bronze colour on every ground, never black.
Type and mesh both read, through contrast colours or an inverse slab, never blend modes.
One message per screen; little text; layouts vary per screen.
Flat UI, deep 3D: all depth belongs to the mesh.

rules.name: The Inverse Rule
rules.body: On yellow, a block is black with yellow type; on black, a block is yellow with black type. White type on black is not used; type on black is yellow.

rules.name: The Own-Colour Rule
rules.body: The mesh is shown in basalt bronze on every ground. It is never black, never tinted by a ground, and nothing inverts it.

rules.name: The No-Blend Rule
rules.body: No mix-blend-mode anywhere. Legibility comes from slabs or clear ground.

rules.name: The One Face for Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every measurement, large or small, is Archivo with tabular figures. No monospace face for figures.

rules.name: The Word-by-Word Rule
rules.body: Headings rise word by word out of their own masks once the screen is reached, then hold their end state.

rules.name: The Flat-UI Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat colour fields separated by hairlines. If a block needs to stand out, it becomes a slab of the inverse colour, not a shadowed card.

dos: Do open on yellow (#fdd001); keep it the majority colour across the story.
Do put type on a contrast colour or an inverse slab: black on yellow, yellow on black.
Do keep every screen to one message and very little text; explain in plain language first, then give the exact figure.
Do set every number in Archivo tabular figures and label it by what it describes (mesh, yarn, concrete).
Do use "3D spacer structure" or "3D woven spacer", and "RTARIUM by HEMISPHERE ONE" for the name.
Do make screen changes one continuous, symmetrical motion in both directions, and honour reduced motion.
Do keep a still image fallback where WebGL is unavailable, and meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast with full keyboard access.
donts: Don't show the mesh in black, or let any ground, blend or filter recolour it.
Don't use mix-blend-mode, cross-fades or colour washes over the mesh (the one intended wash is the tour's white light).
Don't put copy over the 3D or lay out "left text over right 3D".
Don't show concrete outside "Concrete, better than ever.", "In concrete" and Tech Space's own slabs.
Don't use white type on black, shadows on cards, or pills and square chips on the same control.
Don't publish "Diamondcomb", or any figure, test standard, certification or contact detail the client's material does not supply.
Don't resolve the open questions (19.7 vs 20.9 MPa, "impregnated" vs "no chemical top-coatings"); keep them flagged.
